name: agentwatch
description: Multi-agent coordination board for Claude Code and Codex CLI — live claims, event feed, and STOP commands via MCP.

agentwatch.port.description: Port for the AgentWatch MCP server. Both Claude Code and Codex CLI connect here.

agentwatch.claimTtlMinutes.description: How long a file claim stays active before it expires automatically.

agentwatch.coordinationPath.description: Absolute path to the repo being coordinated. Leave empty to use the current workspace folder.

agentwatch.nodePath.description: Path to the Node.js binary used to run the runtime bridges. Leave empty to use 'node' from PATH.

agentwatch.claudePermissionMode.description: Permission mode for the headless Claude (Mode B) runtime bridge. 'acceptEdits' lets it act on the board without prompts; 'bypassPermissions' is fully unattended but less safe.

agentwatch.claudeModel.description: Optional model override for the headless Claude (Mode B) runtime bridge. Leave empty to use your Claude Code default.

agentwatch.subagentBridgeUrl.description: OpenAI-compatible base URL for the continue-llamacpp-bridge backend used by dispatch_subagent (model id selects the GGUF).

agentwatch.subagentOllamaUrl.description: OpenAI-compatible base URL for the Ollama backend used by dispatch_subagent (prefix a model with 'ollama:').

agentwatch.subagentDirectUrl.description: OpenAI-compatible base URL for the direct llama.cpp llama-server backend (prefix a model with 'direct:').

agentwatch.subagentBridgeApiKey.description: API key for the bridge backend, if it requires one.

agentwatch.subagentDefaultBackend.description: Which backend an unprefixed dispatch_subagent model id targets.

agentwatch.defaultAutonomy.description: Initial worker autonomy. 'draft' = workers are read-only and propose diffs (safe). 'clanker' = workers may write/edit/run directly, bounded by the destructive-command denylist. Toggle live with the 💥 board pill or the Toggle Clanker Mode command.
